_comment: Composite VFX animation definitions — authored in the VFX Animation Editor (/test-skills.html). Each animation has a travel phase (back/front layers flying caster→target) and an impact phase (back/front layers at the target). Layers are sheets, sprites, or procedural effects. consumed by src/game/vfx_animations.js.

pfx_cone_of_cold_breath.source: pixelfx:ice/frost-breath (spread 0.55 = the spell cone, margin 60, span crop)

pfx_ice_storm_starfall.source: pixelfx:arcane/star-fall (PAL.ice, 3 seeded layers offset + 0.25s apart, first 2.7s)

pfx_sacred_flame_bless.source: pixelfx:holy/blessing (PAL.holy, no stand-in actor, cone alpha lifted)

pfx_bane_sigil.source: pixelfx:shadow/hex-sigil (PAL.blood, whole, at its authored 4.2 s)

pfx_burning_hands.source: pixelfx:fire/fire-breath (spread 0.55 = the spell cone, margin 60, span crop)
